entries.description: Shipped a machine-checked non-vacuity witness alongside the rule. No error existed; the rule was proved and would have passed every gate. The registry's 'vacuous proof of a true statement' blindness is what made the check obligatory.

Built the reachable-lemma index. Mechanical by the protocol's definition — a friction surface measured (95% of MachLib unreachable from a given file, failing identically to nonexistent names) and tooled, with no judgement about what to work on.
Tool reported a private declaration as reachable from other modules. Caught by testing it against today's own four failures rather than trusting it — the test was the specimen.

findings.description: Const x AboveOne closes conditionally on 1 < exp c - log K. Matrix 11/25 -> 12/25. First cell to move since Phase 17, and the first built on EventuallyAtMost.
